  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - APRIL / MAY 2024  
  SUBJECT: CHM 1071-CHM/CHM 1071-B/CHM 1051-B - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1071-CHM]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          What is meant by ion-selective electrode? Derive an expression for electrode potential of  
  glass electrode and write any two merits of it.                                           (4)  
  
  1B)          Distinguish between the following:  
  i) Activation and Concentration polarization  
  ii) Electroplating and Electroless plating                                                 (4)  
  iii) Fuel Cell and Galvanic Cell  
  iv) Primary and secondary batteries  
  
  1C)          A galvanic cell consists of copper plate immersed in 10 M solution of CuSO4 and iron  
  plate immersed in 1 M FeSO4 at 298 K. Write the cell reaction and calculate E.M.F. of      (2)  
  the cell.  
  
  2A)          i) The concentration of yeast t-RNA in an aqueous solution is 10 M. The absorbance is  
  found to be 0.209 when this Solution is placed in a 1.00 cm cuvette and 258 nm  
  radiations are passed through it.  
  a) Calculate the specific absorptivity, including units, of yeast t-RNA. and  
  b) What will be the absorbance if the solution is 5 M?                                     (4)  
  
  ii) Explain the conductometric titration of weak acid Vs weak base with illustration.  
  (2+2 = 4 marks)  
  
  2B)          Define reverse osmosis. Describe with a neat diagram how sea water is purified using  
  this technique. Write any two advantages of it.                                            (4)  
  
  2C)          i) Define electrodialysis.  
  ii) Distinguish between hard water and soft water (Any two points).                        (2)  
  
  3A)          Discuss the autocatalytic nature of pitting corrosion with a suitable example. Explain  
  any one primary and secondary factor each affecting the rate of pitting corrosion.         (4)  
  
  3B)          Differentiate (Any two points) between anodic and cathodic protection methods of  
  corrosion control. Explain how use of anodic and cathodic inhibitor helps in decreasing    (4)  
  the rate of corrosion.  
  
  3C)          Give reason for the following;                                                             (2)
